rules.result_policy: Measured outputs are immutable evidence; paper targets are comparison fields only.

experiments.name: forward_model_aggregate_mad
experiments.note: Independent recomputation from the exact historical sorted [70:520] selection of 450/600 raw result directories reproduces all five manuscript values at printed precision. A separate modern checkpoint-persisted leakage-safe validation has 12 reusable completed rows but is no longer the primary E01 evidence.

experiments.name: token_augmentation_ablation
experiments.note: All three distinct checkpoints have 600 result directories with exactly identical match-ID sets. Typed augmentation is best on all four recovered metrics. These are recovered historical outputs, not a clean rerun performed by the new harness.

experiments.name: spatial_grid_ablation
experiments.note: All three distinct checkpoints have 600 result directories with exactly identical normalized match-ID sets. Output matrix shapes prove the 4x6, 8x12, and 16x24 mapping. The coarse aggregate used 595/600 because its historical summary script skipped five directories.

experiments.name: repeat_simulation_stability
experiments.note: Complete historical stdout contains 600 matches and 6000 individual runs. Parsed means reproduce 13.87 sample variance and 12.02 pp error exactly at manuscript precision. The original script-declared model filename is currently missing, so clean bit-for-bit rerun provenance is incomplete; the new resumable runner targets the available 340-match checkpoint holdout and now reports both sample and population variance.

experiments.name: policy_comparison
experiments.note: Surviving historical logs were strictly parsed but do not reproduce Table 2 under raw possession gain or absolute-error reduction. They use inconsistent sample construction and are counter-evidence only. The prior uncapped controlled jobs remain stopped. Clean 250-token-capped plain and priors MCTS runs are active on physical GPUs 1 and 0 respectively; a completed one-match priors benchmark took 1303.59 s and measured -4.65 pp.

experiments.name: intervention_frequency
experiments.note: Historical one- and five-minute traces exist, but no authenticated ten-minute run. Exact sweep remains pending.

experiments.name: search_budget
experiments.note: Ambiguous historical filenames suggest settings 1/3/5/7 rather than the required 1/5/10/30/50; exact sweep remains pending.

experiments.name: lookahead_horizon
experiments.note: Historical suffixes do not authenticate the required token horizons; exact sweep remains pending.

experiments.name: active_intervention_cooldown
experiments.note: Decisions are evaluated every minute; after a non-no-op action, active interventions are blocked until the recovery window expires.
